body:
## Context
Issue #1232: `adlc handoff bypass` resolves its ledger from the CLI cwd unless `--dir <path>` is passed, while the Recovery Exception grammar (`SUBCOMMAND_FLAGS.bypass`) in `packages/context-handoff/lib/recovery-exception.mjs` and its Claude Code (`plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/handoff-gate.mjs`) and Codex (`plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/adlc-handoff-gate.mjs`) hook twins omits `--dir`, preventing a session running in a subdirectory from targeting `<repo>/.adlc` under band pressure.
Issues #806 & #800: Ensure `formatRecoveryCommand` output on Windows drive-letter absolute paths (`C:\Program Files\nodejs\node.exe`, `C:\nodejs\node.exe`) round-trips cleanly through `matchRecoveryCommand` across the canonical implementation and both hook twins.

## Acceptance Criteria
- `SUBCOMMAND_FLAGS.bypass` (and `RECOVERY_SUBCOMMAND_FLAGS.bypass` in Codex) accepts `'--dir': 'value'` across `packages/context-handoff/lib/recovery-exception.mjs`, `plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/handoff-gate.mjs`, and `plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/adlc-handoff-gate.mjs`.
- `packages/context-handoff/bin/handoff.mjs`, `packages/context-handoff/README.md`, and `apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/context-handoff.mdx` reflect that `--dir <repo>/.adlc` can be passed directly (not only outside the hook).
- `packages/context-handoff/test/bypass-ledger-dir.test.mjs`, `packages/context-handoff/test/windows-and-residuals.test.mjs`, and the drift tests verify `--dir` acceptance, subdirectory hook invocation, and `formatRecoveryCommand` -> `matchRecoveryCommand` Windows round-tripping.

## Verification
`node --test packages/context-handoff/test/bypass-ledger-dir.test.mjs packages/context-handoff/test/windows-and-residuals.test.mjs packages/context-handoff/adapter-test/cc-helper-drift.test.mjs packages/context-handoff/adapter-test/codex-helper-drift.test.mjs`
title: fix(context-handoff): accept --dir in bypass recovery grammar across all copies and verify Windows round-trip (#1232, #806, #800)
